- VAT rule (BridgeCo: EU company, VAT ID provided): reverse charge applies (no VAT collected by Redwood); invoice will carry buyer VAT ID and a reverse-charge note per EU guidance.
- Final invoice (for AP): 53.20 EUR net; VAT line: 0.00 EUR (reverse charge) with note and references to our EU VAT registration.

I also included a brief payment window (standard 7 days) and a DocuSign link for acceptance if they want a formal addendum.
